tagline: 潘泰康胶片单反相机，1956 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1956年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度1/2 to 1/500 sec. + B.。使用Knob, double exposure prevention.。

specs.卡口: M42 screw mount, no aperture linkage (some variants have a linkage, which can be disengaged if an older lens interferes with it.)
specs.取景器: SLR, waist-level type, auxiliary sport finder.
specs.闪光灯: Dual PC sockets for "F." and X focal plane sync.
specs.英文简介: The Praktica F.X 2 is a relatively early member of the Praktica family, a 35mm SLR introduced by KW in 1956.
